summary: Innate Pharma S.A. filed a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026 attaching a press release announcing a conference call for its third-quarter 2026 business and financial update, scheduled for November 5, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. CET (8:00 a.m. ET). Management participants include CEO Jonathan Dickinson, CMO Markus Jensen, COO Yannis Morel, CFO Frédéric Lombard and IR head Stéphanie Cornen. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, ownership change, regulatory clock or structural mechanic is disclosed; a 90-day webcast replay is noted. This is a routine earnings/update scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal terms to track.
